title: = I33b: the O12 intent contract on M2's window view of the extracted Rollup: a ghost counter (IR 0.3 term), the proof class trace_bound for linear bounds over traces, and a contract-derived law and marks integrated into a real milestone (M2 and its view records)

predictions.claim: L_contract_C_o12 (C_o12's L_weak over gen/M2/extracted/m1_view.json: for every trace p from s0 and window position k, bdf <= bdo + F + g, inch implies W <= g, and inch implies the open challenge started at or before t, with g the ghost sum of W over the successful challengeState steps) is PROVED, by the class trace_bound I65 adds, over the view's current facts. Its proof is accepted by Bend on a re-check in the test, imports exactly its LAWS.bend and states no law; G2, G3, G5 and G9 pass on M2 (GEVID is R1's: O4).

Exactly one record of M0-M3 (results/M0-M3 and results/M2/extracted_m1) is marked: results/M2/extracted_m1/L_undo_cancel.json, filter_bin intended_bounded, intended {contract C_o12, l_weak L_contract_C_o12, replaces finding}; unmarked, it equals its version at the prereg but for generator_sha256 and wall-clock fields. results/M2/contracts.json is the instrument's. G10 on M2 passes from the gate and from the instrument with the detail 'C_o12 proved, marks L_undo_cancel'.

With the planted C_o12_tight (the bound with one second per successful challenge instead of W) registered beside C_o12, holon derive and holon run decide its L_weak REFUTED by the existing refuter (the generator counter, its search evaluating ghost terms by O1; counter-law re-checked by Bend); it marks nothing, C_o12's mark stays, contracts.json lists it 'not proved: REFUTED' with nothing marked, and G10 fails naming it, from the gate and from the instrument.

A change to the view makes C_o12 stale and G10 fail. (a) After a change of a doc string only, holon derive and run prove the L_weak again (trace_bound, Bend re-check), but the view record, decided over the old view, is no longer licensed: no record is marked and G10 passes with 'C_o12 proved'. (b) With challengeState extending by W + 1, the L_weak is REFUTED (counter-law re-checked by Bend), nothing is marked and G10 fails with 'C_o12: not proved: REFUTED'. The gate and the instrument agree at every step.

regressions.claim: G10 is listed under not_applicable on M0 and M1 and passes on M3 with no contract; gates M0, M1 and M2 pass in full (CI jobs gate-M0, gate-M1, gate-M2 on the build head, which merges only once M2's evidence set models the window view: GEVID enforces on the derived law with no exemption, O4, Q62); the M3 gate's failing items are those of the base the build head stands on (at the prereg only G11V on L_disch_rev_initializable_120_d9a34b48, Q36), I65 adding none; the frozen suite, freeze-check and both prereg audits pass (the audits printing O8's amendments).

No commit of I65's own (O9: the non-merge commits of git log --first-parent <prereg>..<end>, end the first commit adding docs/iterations/I65.md) deletes a law or record, or adds one but I65's own files laws/CONTRACTS/C_o12.json, laws/M2/L_contract_C_o12.json, results/M2/L_contract_C_o12.json and results/M2/contracts.json (judged at HEAD by P1 and P2, so later own commits may change them); each other record such a commit changes keeps its status and differs from its parent's version only in generator_sha256, wall-clock fields, prover from absent to 'generator', and, on results/M2/extracted_m1/L_undo_cancel.json alone, P2's mark; no other law file changes but laws/M2/REGISTRY.json (only by that law's statement hash and the view's facts file) and laws/CONTRACTS/REGISTRY.json.

No commit of I65's own changes a frozen root, a law, record or generated file of M3 (results/M3/refute/filter.json included), an M0 record or generated file, or a law of M0 or M1; no contract but C_o12 names M0-M3, which I64-R1 as amended at this prereg (O8) checks too.

Construction checks, not counted as predictions, each needing the built tree: the instruments and fixture are the key's (pins); the schema admits the ghost term and refuses five malformed ones, and the Q4 package follows it; Bend computes the committed ghost helper on GHOST_CASES from LAWS.bend's helpers alone (no open goal) and refuses each value plus one on the value; the contract is committed, registered and the only one on M0-M3; the derived law is listed in the registry (its primary facts unchanged), bound, absent from DERIVATION.json, ledger_match exact, lean4 not_run unsupported_form with the view's Lean model file in gen/M2/lean/models/ and no law file, and holon derive reproduces laws/M2 byte for byte; trace_bound proves the second claim C_o12_open; holon/ names no I65 id; an ambiguous scope law is refused by apply and fails G10; a record over other facts loses its mark; G10 fails on a missing, foreign or half mark of the view record; holon differential with holon refute's final filter, and the filter alone, keep the mark.

thresholds.lean: the derived law's lean4 entry comes from M2's own Lean directory (gen/M2/lean) and is not_run with reason unsupported_form (allowed for a PROVED law by holon.gen.lean_common.ALLOWED_REASONS): no Lean emitter renders a ghost term. By I43's rule L4 the directory holds the model file of the Bend model its law uses, gen/M2/lean/models/m1_view.lean, emitted and checked like any model, its Lean twin library taken from the view's abstraction. I65 adds no Lean twin of the ghost term or of trace_bound, so Q8's promotion is not met for this one law, which the report states
